_comment: PLACEHOLDERS. Nothing can be bought yet: there is no payment provider and no server to record a purchase, and every button that would take money says so instead. These are the shapes the store and the Support page will have, and the prices are first guesses from the business plan. Everything here is also earnable by playing, except Supporter, which is a thank-you rather than an unlock.

bundles._comment: Featured: the banner at the top of the store.
bundles.name: Founder's Pack
bundles.blurb: Every builder, the Founder title and badge, and the Gilded Keep fortress

supporter._comment: One purchase, for good. The Support page shows the pitch and lists the perks; {bonus} in a perk is filled in from progression.json's supporter.bonus and {boost} from its adBoost.bonus, so the page and the XP it pays cannot disagree.
supporter.pitch: Lane Siege is made by one developer. If you are enjoying it, becoming a Supporter is the most direct way to keep it going - and it changes nothing about who wins.
perks: +{bonus} XP on every match, for good
The +{boost} XP boost always on, no ads
A Supporter badge by your name
